description: Victorian Waterway Boating Zone Data is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport Safety Victoria. Boating activity on Victoria's waterways is governed by rules that are determined by Transport Safety Victoria in accordance with the powers of the Marine Safety Act 2010 (Vic). Those rules are published as the Vessel Operating and Zoning Rules (VOZR). Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Transport Safety Victoria. Its tags are Boating Zones, Maritime Safety, TSV, Victorian Waterways. It offers 1 resource(s) in ZIP. The portal shows 2025-06-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support inland waterway and lock studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
